sentences.en: His victories have been too pyrrhic.
sentences.zh: 此外，克劳狄家族在击败迦太基人的过程中也发挥了主导作用。

sentences.en: And also Claudians play a leading role in the defeat of the Carthaginians.
sentences.zh: 但克劳狄家族的记录中也存在黑暗的一面。

sentences.en: But there is also a dark strain to the record of Claudian achievement.
sentences.zh: 他们中的一些人被视为极度令人憎恨。

sentences.en: Some of them are viewed with great hatred.
sentences.zh: 再次提到对抗迦太基人，有一个关于一位克劳狄家族成员的臭名昭著的故事，他率领一支战斗舰队对抗迦太基人。

sentences.en: So again, fighting against the Carthaginians, there's a notorious story of one Claudian who is leading a battle fleet against the Carthaginians.
sentences.zh: 他让占卜师去查看旗舰上的神圣鸡只。

sentences.en: He gets the soothsayer to consult the holy chickens that are on board his flagship.
sentences.zh: 占卜师说，不，恐怕鸡只在说不要进攻。

sentences.en: And the soothsayer, no, I'm afraid that the chickens are saying don't attack.
sentences.zh: 提比略直接把鸡扔进了海里，结果很快就损失了整个舰队。

sentences.en: And Tiberius just has the chickens chucked into the sea and promptly loses his entire fleet.
sentences.zh: 克劳狄家族的女性也同样既受人钦佩又受人谴责。

sentences.en: And the women of the Claudians also are simultaneously admired and condemned.
sentences.zh: 有一个女人的贞洁是如此惊人，据说她能单枪匹马把一艘船一直拉上台伯河。

sentences.en: So there's one of them whose chastity is so prodigious that she's able single-handedly, it's said, to pull a ship right the way up the Tiber.
sentences.zh: 还有另一个女人，就是那个把鸡扔进海里的克劳狄家族成员的姐妹，她正乘马车穿过罗马。

sentences.en: And there's another one, the sister of the Claudian who chucked the chickens in the sea, who is driving through Rome in her carriage.
sentences.zh: 到处都是人群。

sentences.en: There are crowds everywhere.
sentences.zh: 她非常愤怒。

sentences.en: She's furious.
sentences.zh: 她被堵在交通堵塞中。

sentences.en: She's stuck in a traffic jam.
sentences.zh: 她说，哦，要是我的兄弟在场，能在某场可怕的战败中多杀掉几个这些讨厌的平民就好了。

sentences.en: And she says, oh, if only my brother were around to kill off a few more of these awful crowds in some terrible defeat.
sentences.zh: 她因此被指控叛国，这是

sentences.en: And she gets accused of treason for this, the only woman in
sentences.zh: 罗马历史上直到那时为止唯一被指控叛国的女性。

sentences.en: Roman history to be accused of treason up until that point.
sentences.zh: 所以他们非常有魅力。

sentences.en: So they're very charismatic.
sentences.zh: 所以有很多人恨他们。

sentences.en: So there are lots of people who hate them.
sentences.zh: 我认为想象他们在罗马共和国地位的最好方式，就是想象在美国共和国，假设肯尼迪家族

sentences.en: And I think that maybe the best way to imagine that their kind of status in the Roman Republic is to imagine that in the American Republic, suppose the Kennedys had
sentences.zh: 从开国元勋时代起就一直活跃在政坛，有一连串的肯尼迪担任总统。

sentences.en: been on the scene, you know, since the days of the founding fathers, that there'd been successions of Kennedys who'd been presidents.
sentences.zh: 人们恨他们。

sentences.en: People hate them.
sentences.zh: 人们爱他们。

sentences.en: People love them.
sentences.zh: 这就是克劳狄家族所拥有的那种魅力。

sentences.en: It's that kind of charisma that the Claudians have.
sentences.zh: 对提比略来说更糟糕的是，或者更好，取决于你的观点，他的母亲和父亲都出自克劳狄家族的不同分支，不是吗？

sentences.en: And what's even worse for Tiberius, or better, depending on your viewpoint, is that both his mother and his father are descended from branches of the Claudian family, aren't they?
sentences.zh: 所以

sentences.en: So the
sentences.zh: 肯尼迪家族已经在这里待了200年，而你的父母双方都来自那个家族的不同分支。

sentences.en: Kennedys have been here for 200 years, and both of your parents are from different branches of that family.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So he is born two years after the Ides of March.
sentences.zh: 所以他出生在“三月十五日”之后两年。

sentences.en: Everything has kicked off, civil war, and actually his father, for all his prestige and all the sort of grandeur of his name,
sentences.zh: 当时局势动荡，内战爆发，而他的父亲，尽管拥有显赫的声望和家族名望，

sentences.en: has backed the wrong side, hasn't he, in the civil war after Julius Caesar's assassination?
sentences.zh: 却在尤利乌斯·凯撒遇刺后的内战中站错了队，不是吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So he has to kind of leave Italy in fear of his life.
sentences.zh: 所以他不得不为了保命而离开意大利。

sentences.en: And he does so with his wife,
sentences.zh: 他带着妻子莉薇娅，

sentences.en: Livia, and his baby son, Tiberius.
sentences.zh: 还有尚在襁褓中的儿子提比略一同出逃。

sentences.en: And they go first to Sicily, where Tiberius, his father, is very arrogant, as all the Claudians are supposedly arrogant.
sentences.zh: 他们先去了西西里岛，在那里，提比略的父亲表现得非常傲慢，毕竟克劳狄家族的人向来被认为很傲慢。

sentences.en: So he has a bust up there with the guy in charge of Sicily.
sentences.zh: 因此，他和西西里岛的负责人闹翻了。

sentences.en: And then he goes to Greece.
sentences.zh: 接着他去了希腊。

sentences.en: And there, they're in Sparta, and there's a terrible fire, and they have to escape.
sentences.zh: 他们在斯巴达时遭遇了一场可怕的火灾，不得不逃生。

sentences.en: And Livia's hair gets singed.
sentences.zh: 莉薇娅的头发都被烧焦了。

sentences.en: So all kinds of close shaves, and it's looking very bad for him.
sentences.zh: 总之，他们经历了各种九死一生，处境非常糟糕。

sentences.en: So eventually, he goes to Antony, who is ruler of the eastern half of the empire, and makes up with him.
sentences.zh: 最终，他投奔了统治帝国东部的安东尼，并与他言归于好。

sentences.en: And there's an amnesty proclaimed.
sentences.zh: 随后颁布了大赦令。

sentences.en: And Tiberius' father,
sentences.zh: 提比略的父亲、

sentences.en: Livia, and the baby Tiberius, are then able to go back to Rome, where an incredible scandal breaks out.
sentences.zh: 莉薇娅和幼年的提比略得以回到罗马，随即爆发了一场惊人的丑闻。

sentences.en: Because while Antony's in the east, Augustus, as he will come to be known, is the ruler of Rome.
sentences.zh: 因为当安东尼在东方时，奥古斯都（后来人们这样称呼他）是罗马的统治者。

sentences.en: And so Tiberius' parents are now in the shadow of Augustus, and Suetonius reports the consequence.
sentences.zh: 提比略的父母现在处于奥古斯都的阴影之下，苏维托尼乌斯记录了随之而来的后果。

sentences.en: It was with Antony that Tiberius' father returned to Rome.
sentences.zh: 提比略的父亲正是随安东尼回到罗马的。

sentences.en: And here, pressed by Augustus to surrender him his wife, Livia.
sentences.zh: 在这里，他受到奥古斯都的压力，被迫交出自己的妻子莉薇娅。

sentences.en: Despite the fact that Livia was pregnant at the time, and had already born him a son, he did so.
sentences.zh: 尽管当时莉薇娅已经怀孕，且已经为他生下了一个儿子，但他还是照做了。

sentences.en: He died not long afterwards, and was survived by two sons, Tiberius and his younger brother, Drusus.
sentences.zh: 他不久后便去世了，留下了两个儿子：提比略和他的弟弟德鲁苏斯。

sentences.en: So, very shocking.
sentences.zh: 真是令人震惊。

sentences.en: Yeah, a quick question.
sentences.zh: 没错，问个简单的问题。

sentences.en: So are we to believe that this is basically, that Augustus has genuinely fallen in love with this bloke's wife?
sentences.zh: 我们是否应该相信，这基本上是因为奥古斯都真的爱上了这个家伙的妻子？

sentences.en: It's a genuine love match.
sentences.zh: 这是一段真挚的爱情。

sentences.en: I mean, that's the only explanation, isn't it, really?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这确实是唯一的解释，不是吗？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Crucially, Livia does not give Augustus any children, and particularly any sons.
sentences.zh: 关键在于，莉薇娅没有给奥古斯都生下任何孩子，尤其是没有生下儿子。

sentences.en: And so this opens up the massive question of who is going to succeed him.
sentences.zh: 这引出了一个巨大的问题：谁将成为他的继任者？

sentences.en: It's obviously very useful for
sentences.zh: 对于提比略和他的弟弟德鲁苏斯来说，

sentences.en: Tiberius and his younger brother, Drusus, to be the stepsons of the most powerful man in the world, the stepsons of Augustus.
sentences.zh: 能成为世界上最有权势的人——奥古斯都的继子，显然是非常有利的。

sentences.en: But equally, it does redound greatly to Augustus' prestige to have a Claudian wife and two Claudian stepsons.
sentences.zh: 但同样，拥有一位克劳狄家族的妻子和两位克劳狄家族的继子，也极大地提升了奥古斯都的声望。

sentences.en: Because although Augustus is the grandson of
sentences.zh: 因为尽管奥古斯都是尤利乌斯·凯撒的孙子，

sentences.en: Julius Caesar, his own father had not been a prestigious figure.
sentences.zh: 但他自己的父亲并非什么显赫人物。

sentences.en: He'd basically been a kind of out-of-town guy.
sentences.zh: 他基本上只是个外地人。

sentences.en: He's representative of the Italian nobility, not of the kind of high patrician Roman nobility.
sentences.zh: 他代表的是意大利贵族，而非那种罗马的高门望族。

sentences.en: So it's good for him.
sentences.zh: 所以这对奥古斯都很有利。

sentences.en: It kind of upgrades his status.
sentences.zh: 这提升了他的地位。

sentences.en: And what is also very useful for Augustus is that Tiberius, as he grows up in Augustus' family, proves to be a man of remarkable accomplishment.
sentences.zh: 对奥古斯都同样有用的是，提比略在奥古斯都的家庭中成长，证明自己是一位成就非凡的人。

sentences.en: And Suetonius gives us all the details of this.
sentences.zh: 苏维托尼乌斯为我们提供了所有细节。

sentences.en: Suetonius reports that
sentences.zh: 苏维托尼乌斯记载，

sentences.en: Tiberius is exceedingly clever, exceedingly well-read, very, very interested in all kinds of
sentences.zh: 提比略极其聪明，博学多才，对各种知识追求都非常感兴趣，

sentences.en: intellectual pursuits, and particularly in mythology, in the study of the gods, and in the literature of Greece and Rome.
sentences.zh: 特别是在神话学、神学研究以及希腊和罗马文学方面。

sentences.en: He's also a very effective administrator.
sentences.zh: 他也是一位非常高效的行政管理者。

sentences.en: So even as a very young man, he's charged by Augustus, again, to quote Suetonius here, making up a shortfall in the supply of grain to Rome.
sentences.zh: 所以，即使在很年轻的时候，他就被奥古斯都委以重任——再次引用苏维托尼乌斯的话——去补足罗马的粮食供应缺口。

sentences.en: I mean, that's a crucial thing.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这至关重要。

sentences.en: If Rome is not kept supplied, then Augustus' regime will topple.
sentences.zh: 如果罗马的供应得不到保障，奥古斯都的政权就会垮台。

sentences.en: So it's a real marker of truSt. And then Augustus commissions the young Tiberius to launch
sentences.zh: 所以这确实是信任的标志。随后，奥古斯都又委派年轻的提比略发起

sentences.en: a thorough investigation into the slave barracks across Italy, the owners of which had a terrible
sentences.zh: 对意大利各地奴隶营的彻底调查，这些奴隶营的主人因不仅抓捕和囚禁旅行者，

sentences.en: reputation for seizing and imprisoning not just travellers, but men whose fear of military service had driven them to hide out there.
sentences.zh: 还抓捕那些因害怕服兵役而躲藏在那里的人而臭名昭著。

sentences.en: And again, that's really important because Augustus does not want his regime to be associated with conditions of internal instability.
sentences.zh: 这再次显得非常重要，因为奥古斯都不希望他的政权与内部不稳定的状况联系在一起。

sentences.en: He wants order, really important for his popularity.
sentences.zh: 他想要秩序，这对他的声望至关重要。

sentences.en: So this is a real kind of demonstration of his trust in Tiberius.
sentences.zh: 所以这确实证明了奥古斯都对提比略的信任。

sentences.en: And then on top of that, Tiberius proves to be a brilliant military leader, by far the best of his generation.
sentences.zh: 不仅如此，提比略还证明了自己是一位杰出的军事领袖，是这一代人中当之无愧的最强者。

sentences.en: To the extent that later in his life, whenever there is a major crisis on the frontiers, it is Tiberius to whom Augustus turns.
sentences.zh: 以至于在他晚年，每当边境出现重大危机时，奥古斯都总是求助于提比略。

sentences.en: And it's not going too far to say that Tiberius is twice the saviour of his country.
sentences.zh: 说提比略两次拯救了他的国家并不为过。

sentences.en: So the first of these great feats of repairing Rome and ensuring that her frontiers are not overwhelmed takes place in 86 when there's a great revolt in Pannonia.
sentences.zh: 第一次伟大的壮举是在公元6年，当时潘诺尼亚爆发了大起义，他修复了罗马并确保边境不被攻破。

sentences.en: So basically what's now Hungary, he crushes that.
sentences.zh: 基本上就是现在的匈牙利地区，他平定了那里。

sentences.en: And the second is in the aftermath of the great disaster of
sentences.zh: 第二次是在奥古斯都统治时期那场大灾难之后，

sentences.en: Augustus's reign, which is the defeat of the three legions under the command of Varus by the Germans in 89.
sentences.zh: 即公元9年，瓦鲁斯指挥的三个军团被日耳曼人击败。

sentences.en: And it's Tiberius who ensures that that disaster does not lead to the complete collapse of the frontier and Germans flooding into Gaul and Italy.
sentences.zh: 正是提比略确保了那场灾难没有导致边境彻底崩溃，也没有让日耳曼人涌入高卢和意大利。

sentences.en: So Suetonius quotes a letter that Augustus wrote to Tiberius during these kind of later years, in which he writes to Tiberius and addresses him as
sentences.zh: 苏维托尼乌斯引用了奥古斯都在这些晚年时期写给提比略的一封信，他在信中称呼提比略为

sentences.en: dearest and bravest and most dutiful of generals.
sentences.zh: 最亲爱、最勇敢、最尽职的将军。

sentences.en: So, you know, this is a very, very impressive man.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，这是一个非常、非常令人印象深刻的人。

sentences.en: So if you were pointing purely on merit, Tiberius is obviously, obviously the best qualified,
sentences.zh: 所以如果你纯粹从能力出发，提比略显然是条件最好、

sentences.en: the outstanding candidate to succeed Augustus when the time comes as emperor, as master of the Roman world.
sentences.zh: 最杰出的候选人，当时间到来时，他理应继承奥古斯都，成为罗马世界的统治者。

sentences.en: But we know from Suetonius's account, that Augustus basically tries to do everything possible, not everything possible to avoid it,
sentences.zh: 但我们从苏维托尼乌斯的记载中知道，奥古斯都基本上想尽了一切办法，并不是说他想尽办法避免这一点，

sentences.en: but he's constantly looking at other candidates from his own family.
sentences.zh: 而是他一直在从自己的家族中寻找其他候选人。

sentences.en: So Tiberius is his stepson, not his son.
sentences.zh: 因为提比略是他的继子，而不是亲生儿子。

sentences.en: And what Augustus really wants is his own flesh and blood.
sentences.zh: 奥古斯都真正想要的是自己的骨肉。

sentences.en: So his grandsons to succeed him because he's had a daughter, hasn't he, Augustus, called Julia, who is not his daughter by Livia, but by a previous wife.
sentences.zh: 他希望自己的孙子继承他，因为奥古斯都曾有一个女儿叫朱莉娅，她不是莉薇娅所生，而是前妻所生。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And he wants her children to succeed him, not this guy who's somebody else's son.
sentences.zh: 他希望她的孩子继承他，而不是这个别人的儿子。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Because that's what every Roman nobleman wants.
sentences.zh: 因为那是每个罗马贵族都想要的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: They want their bloodline to be perpetuated.
sentences.zh: 他们希望自己的血脉得以延续。

sentences.en: So Julia has given him various kind of grandsons and granddaughters.
sentences.zh: 朱莉娅为他生了几个孙子和孙女。

sentences.en: And Augustus has adopted the eldest of his three grandsons, guys called Gaius and Lucius, directly as his sons.
sentences.zh: 奥古斯都直接收养了他三个孙子中的长子，即盖乌斯和卢基乌斯，作为自己的儿子。

sentences.en: So this is marking them out as the heirs.
sentences.zh: 这标志着他们是继承人。

sentences.en: And Tiberius is very, very sensitive to the fact that he's not in the line of succession.
sentences.zh: 提比略对自己不在继承序列中非常、非常敏感。

sentences.en: And he makes a real point of trying not to tread on the toes of Gaius and Lucius, who of course are much younger than him, much less experienced, much less able.
sentences.zh: 他刻意不去触碰盖乌斯和卢基乌斯的利益，当然，他们比他年轻得多，经验少得多，能力也差得多。

sentences.en: And he, you know, he does his best, but he is a Claudian.
sentences.zh: 他尽力了，但他毕竟是克劳狄家族的人。

sentences.en: I mean, he's a very proud man and he can't really help but betray his resentment.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他是一个非常骄傲的人，无法掩饰自己的怨恨。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: So this happens in various ways.
sentences.zh: 这种情况以各种方式表现出来。

sentences.en: So Augustus marries Julia, his daughter, to Tiberius and Tiberius and Julia don't get on at all.
sentences.zh: 奥古斯都把女儿朱莉娅嫁给了提比略，但提比略和朱莉娅根本合不来。

sentences.en: At one point, Tiberius is so aggravated by the situation he finds himself that he chucks everything in and he retires to Rhodes.
sentences.zh: 有一次，提比略对自己的处境感到非常愤怒，他放弃了一切，隐居到了罗德岛。

sentences.en: And he does it in a way that seems very openly to insult Augustus, who has publicly requested him not to go.
sentences.zh: 他这样做的方式似乎是在公开羞辱奥古斯都，因为奥古斯都曾公开请求他不要离开。

sentences.en: And relations between the two men break down so badly that in the event when Tiberius says, well, I can't, I've had enough of Rhodes.
sentences.zh: 两人之间的关系恶化到了极点，以至于当提比略说，好吧，我受够了罗德岛，

sentences.en: I want to come back now.
sentences.zh: 我现在想回来。

sentences.en: Augustus forbids it.
sentences.zh: 奥古斯都拒绝了。

sentences.en: So effectively, Tiberius is in exile.
sentences.zh: 所以实际上，提比略处于流放状态。

sentences.en: And actually in a measure of danger from Lucius and Gaius, who, you know, obviously in turn feel menaced by this very able, it's their kind of elder.
sentences.zh: 而且实际上还面临着来自卢基乌斯和盖乌斯的危险，他们显然也觉得这位非常有能力的“长辈”对自己构成了威胁。

sentences.en: But then in, first of all, in 82,
sentences.zh: 但后来，首先是在公元2年，

sentences.en: Lucius dies and then in 84, Gaius dies.
sentences.zh: 卢基乌斯去世了，接着在公元4年，盖乌斯也去世了。

sentences.en: And this is basically the kind of the plot twist in I, Claudius, that it's Livia, Tiberius's mother, who is poisoning them and kind of elbowing aside
sentences.zh: 这基本上就是《我，克劳狄》中的情节转折，即是提比略的母亲莉薇娅毒死了他们，并排挤掉

sentences.en: anyone who might stand in the path of her son to succeed to the throne.
sentences.zh: 任何可能阻碍她儿子继承王位的人。
